description: Internal part of TmGantt (hidden from the editor): the view-settings list — the today marker, days off, progress label and closed-tasks toggles, the task name location, the row density, the theme and (with NotificationSettings) the notification preferences. The toolbar renders it as the popover of the "View settings" button; the mobile "More" sheet renders the same list as its second view. Place TmGantt, not this component.

parameters.name: Owner
parameters.description: The TmGantt this part belongs to. Internal: TmGantt places the part itself; a host never does.

parameters.name: Open
parameters.description: Whether the list renders (the toolbar's popover state, or always inside the mobile More sheet).

parameters.name: Sheet
parameters.description: Sheet presentation (the mobile More sheet): no click-away overlay, the menu is a static block.
